messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Javier Madrid <j.madrid@therahealth.com>, Liz Chen <liz.chen@therahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Segmentation & SOC2/GDPR handoff — next steps

Hi Javier / Liz — thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the technical deep-dive:

Summary from call
- TheraHealth is evaluating a private deployment of Redwood (VPC / dedicated) for regulatory reasons: HIPAA (PHI), GDPR considerations for EU users, and internal segmentation requirements.
- Current compliance posture: SOC 2 Type I complete; Type II expected later in the year (you mentioned Q4).
- Primary ask: network isolation diagram, evidence list for vendor questionnaire, clarity on where PHI will be processed and retention rules.

Action items we promised
1) Javier: share the high-level network sketch you referenced and the SIG-lite that your procurement team starts with (we can map our evidence to it).
2) Redwood (Markus / Jordan): propose times for a 60–90m technical deep-dive (architecture + threat model) and prepare a list of evidence items to start collecting.
3) Marissa: begin vendor questionnaire intake and surface obvious gaps for SOC / encryption / key management.

Questions we still need from you
- Do you expect PHI to ever leave a US-only region for processing? (you mentioned EU residency for some users)
- Are air-gapped / on-prem appliance options a hard requirement or an escalation path if the private VPC option is insufficient?
- Expected throughput: can you share expected concurrent requests and token volumes (rough ballpark is fine) so we size an initial offering?

Proposed next steps
- Javier, if you can drop the sketch + any partial SIG fields by EOD Thursday (2028-06-22), we’ll map evidence to your procurement timeline.
- Jordan & Markus: we’ll propose 3 times for a follow-up deep-dive (preferred next week).
- Marissa: will start the evidence intake and flag what requires SOC 2 Type II vs shorter-term mitigations.

Thanks — I’m assigning owners in the thread below.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 415-555-0124

--
Attachment stubs referenced: therA_network_sketch_v1.png (you), SIG-lite-thera.csv (procurement)

From: Javier Madrid <j.madrid@therahealth.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Segmentation & SOC2/GDPR handoff — next steps

Evelyn — thanks for the clear notes. Sharing the items you asked for: attached is a very small network sketch (thera_network_sketch_v1.png) and a partially completed SIG-lite CSV that our vendor team uses. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we completed Type I in Jan 2028. Type II is expected end of Q4 2028 — procurement will treat Type II as the baseline for production but can accept compensating controls in the interim.
- PHI residency: our default is US-only for PHI. We have EU users, but PHI tags are only for US patients; we can confirm enforcement tooling on our side.
- Air-gap: not a hard requirement today, but if the deployment cannot meet our audit firewall segmentation (no egress without explicit rule), we may need an appliance-based option. Consider this an escalation path.
- Throughput: initial PoC: 50 concurrent API sessions with ~1k tokens per session/day. Production target (12 months): 1,200 concurrent sessions peak, ~30M tokens/day.

We’ll need an itemized evidence list mapped to the SIG-lite. Also please include the expected timeline and expected cost delta for a private VPC vs hosted API (ballpark).

Thanks — attaching now.

Regards,
Javier Madrid
Head of Platform Security | TheraHealth
j.madrid@therahealth.com

Attachments: therA_network_sketch_v1.png (stub); SIG-lite-thera.csv (stub)

Thanks Javier — received the sketch and SIG-lite. Quick replies and proposed slots for the deep-dive: Tuesday 2028-06-27 10:00–11:30 PT, Wednesday 2028-06-28 13:00–14:30 PT, or Thursday 2028-06-29 08:30–10:00 PT. Which works best?

Technical clarifications we’ll cover in the session:
- Expected auth flows (SAML / OIDC, SCIM provisioning) and whether you will terminate TLS at your edge or at Redwood.
- KV cache and prefix-caching policies — can TheraHealth accept cached prefixes for non-PHI traffic? If PHI must never be cached, we’ll show how we can tag those requests and isolate them.
- Network segmentation: we’ll present separation patterns (tenant-level subnets, NAT/no-egress policies, egress proxies) and an air-gap fallback (appliance + HSM options).
- Key management: our default is KMS integration (customer-managed keys supported).

Pre-read: I’ve uploaded a short HLD (link below) and a checklist of items we’ll need to answer. If you can confirm the expected token volumes by Monday EOD, we’ll include a capacity estimate.

Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/rdw-3491-deepdive

Hi all — looping in Redwood security intake. I’ve started the vendor questionnaire intake and attached the SIG-lite CSV with our initial mapping (SIG-lite-thera.csv). Quick notes on evidence we’ll surface and questions for TheraHealth procurement:

Evidence we’ll provide (where available)
- SOC 2 Type I report (available) and notes on Type II timeline.
- Encryption at rest: AES-256, customer KMS option (we’ll provide KMS integration guide).
- Network controls: VPC peering diagram, ACL/NACL examples, firewall rule templates, and egress control patterns.
- Audit logs: per-request logs retained by default 90 days (longer retention available in Dedicated / Private).

Open items for TheraHealth
- BAA: we will provide a standard BAA template; please confirm your legal & procurement point of contact.
- Required retention windows for audit logs and export format for evidence.
- Any additional custom encryption/HSM requirements for keys in an air-gapped deployment.

As part of intake I’m assigning owners: I’ll own the evidence mapping & SOC questions, Jordan will lead the architecture thread, Markus will scope KMS/HSM options. Please send any procurement deadlines — if you need a formal evidence package by next Wednesday (2028-06-28) we can prioritize.

Marissa Cole
